title: Comparison of addition variants (cls, step_ar, ar, addressed_ar)
question: Across the four addition variants—parallel classification per step (cls), sequential predictions per step with harness state updates (step_ar), unrolled full-trace autoregressive generation (ar), and full-trace autoregressive generation with explicit base-B column addresses (addressed_ar)—how do convergence speed, in-domain accuracy, and zero-shot base and length transfer compare?
